name: kb_batched_matmul
description: Batched matrix multiplication (BMM): C = A @ B where A, B, and C share the same batch dimension. This is the fundamental operation for attention mechanisms and batched linear layers in transformers.

batch_size.description: Number of independent matrix multiplications to perform in parallel

m.description: Number of rows in A and C

k.description: Shared inner dimension (columns in A, rows in B)

n.description: Number of columns in B and C

name: kb_batched_matmul_transposed_b
description: Batched matrix multiplication with transposed B: C = A @ B^T. Common in attention score computation where B represents keys.

batch_size.description: Number of independent matrix multiplications to perform in parallel

m.description: Number of rows in A and C

k.description: Shared inner dimension (columns in A and B)

n.description: Number of rows in B and columns in C

name: kb_batched_matmul_fp32_accum
description: Batched matrix multiplication with float32 accumulation for higher precision. Input and output remain bfloat16 but intermediate accumulation uses float32.

batch_size.description: Number of independent matrix multiplications to perform in parallel

m.description: Number of rows in A and C

k.description: Shared inner dimension (columns in A, rows in B)

n.description: Number of columns in B and C
